evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Nicole jumps directly to the walkthrough offer with no time-boxed framing or promise of a dependable quote. No 'Does that sound good to you?' wait.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Move date (Monday, Sept 28) and square footage (1900) confirmed in opening. City-to-city route and approximate size inferred but name (Ryan) confirmed. Missing explicit city-to-city route probing.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_branch: Nicole correctly identifies 1,900 sq ft triggers the virtual walkthrough: 'Upon checking the square footage of your townhome moving from 1900 square footage we usually do a virtual walkthrough, it's like a video call on your preferred time and date.'
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. No version of 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' Nicole moves directly into logistics and pricing education.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Asked: 'And do you also need our help packing your small items into boxes or will you be able to do it yourself?' Customer declined.
evidence_quotes.pricing_explanation: Nicole delivers substantial pricing education (hourly rate $102/mover, trip fee $75, what's included, no hidden fees, damage coverage $2,000, on-time guarantee, meet-your-mover, no deposit, 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments) but this is done *before* the walkthrough, not as an estimate anchor tied to this customer's specific move.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Time confirmed (12:00 PM today), link sent and confirmed received. Date confirmed (Monday Sept 28). Missing: explicit addresses, crew size (deferred to walkthrough), arrival window specificity, notes for crew about concerns.

top_strength: Nicole correctly identified the 1,900 sq ft threshold and properly routed to a virtual walkthrough instead of attempting an inaccurate on-call quote, and she delivered comprehensive pricing education upfront so the customer understands the rate structure before the walkthrough call.
coaching_note: Ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' in Section 2 before pivoting to logistics — even on a walkthrough-routed call, understanding their agenda first builds trust and informs the walkthrough conversation itself.
